run_train_task: run the tactile SSL training pipeline with hydra config and wandb logging
init_wandb: initialize a wandb run with project entity group tags and notes from config
get_dataloader_digit: build train and validation dataloaders for digit or gelsight tactile sensor datasets
get_dataloader_reskin: build train and validation dataloaders for reskin tactile sensor datasets using ConcatDataset
attempt_resume: attempt to resume a previous experiment from saved checkpoints and wandb logs
